<a id="loops-lie-within-what-a-law-reads-and-the-loop-that-acts-through-a-stock-forms-at-its-break--回路在律所读之内经储量起作用的回路在断裂处形成"></a>
# Loops lie within what a law reads, and the loop that acts through a stock forms at its break

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`loops-within-what-a-law-reads` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](loops-within-what-a-law-reads.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Unread levels couple with strength zero, so loops lie within what a law reads; for every law reading a stock only below a threshold, a raise is carried nowhere up to the break, before which the law acts as its standing law, with no loop through the stock: the loop that acts forms at the break.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A law reads a schedule when, for each formation outside the part, it gives alike under histories agreeing up to the step on the conditions marked. An unread level is coupled with strength zero, so the strengths restricted to what is read are strengths of the law. Every law of what has stood reads everything; a law reading through the couplings reads every schedule covering what couples in, and its courses are policies through the couplings. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsAt`, `Becoming.restrictReads`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsAt.respondsWithin_unread`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsAt.restrict`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.readsAt_all`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Through.readsAt`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Through.policyThrough`)
2. Loops lie within what is read: every coupling of the restricted strengths reads its level; a draw responds to the level it lowers only where it reads it; downstream of a level nothing reads lies only itself, and no loop passes through it; a loop forms at a step only through a formation reading there a level downstream of where it gives. (`Becoming.Thresholds.cond_pos`, `Becoming.Thresholds.pos_cond`, `Becoming.couplesAt_reads`, `Becoming.couplesAt_of_reads`, `Becoming.couples_reads`, `Becoming.self_coupling_reads`, `Becoming.upstream_unread`, `Becoming.not_onLoop_unread`, `Becoming.onLoop_succ_reads`)
3. What nothing reads is carried nowhere: for every law reading a schedule, two balanced courses with the same formations present, the part acting alike and the rest following the law, apart at the start only in a stock, are alike everywhere else, the stock's gap held, until something outside the part reads the stock. (`Becoming.Thresholds.raise_step`, `Becoming.Thresholds.same_step`, `Becoming.held_while`, `Becoming.unread_carried_nowhere`)
4. The break: a law reads a stock only below a threshold when, while the stock stands at the threshold, it reads only that it stands; every law reading through couplings by which the stock couples into each formation outside the part by threshold only, with the threshold at least each need of it, is such a law. For every such law, however much the stock is raised, up to the break everything else is alike and the stock stands higher by the raise: the distance to the break is carried nowhere. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsBelow`, `Becoming.break_carried_nowhere`, `Becoming.Thresholds.le_of_not_not`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Through.readsBelow`)
5. Before the break the law acts as its standing law, reading the stock as standing at its threshold wherever it stands below it; the standing law does not read the stock, is coupled to it with strength zero and has no loop through it, only the stock lying downstream of it: the loop that acts through the stock forms at the break. The stock is marked among the conditions by a marking given with it, so no decision on conditions is used. (`Becoming.standAt`, `Becoming.offStock`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.standing`, `Becoming.standAt_stock`, `Becoming.standAt_unmarked`, `Becoming.standAt_of_stands`, `Becoming.offStock_stock`, `Becoming.offStock_other`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsBelow.standing_readsAt`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsBelow.standing_unread`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsBelow.standing_no_loop`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.standing_alike`, `Becoming.Flow.follows_standing_before`)
6. The draw witness: a formation draws one unit from a stock and gives it to a product at each step while the stock stands at N + 1, reading the stock only below N + 1. Every strengths of it couple the stock into itself, a loop of one, while before the break it gives as its standing law, with strength zero from the stock; at a step where one course's stock stands below the threshold and a raised one's at it, the raised course gives one more to the product across that step. (`Becoming.Thresholds.Draw.law`, `Becoming.Thresholds.Draw.nonanticipating`, `Becoming.Thresholds.Draw.reads`, `Becoming.Thresholds.Draw.strength_pos`, `Becoming.Thresholds.Draw.onLoop`, `Becoming.Thresholds.Draw.only`, `Becoming.Thresholds.Draw.forms_at_break`, `Becoming.Thresholds.Draw.diverges_at_break`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. What each theorem needs is written into it: the schedule a law reads (ReadsAt) or its reading a stock only below a threshold (ReadsBelow); the strengths k as supplied bounds; two balanced courses with the same formations present, the part acting alike and the rest following the law, apart at the start only in the stock; the agreement with the standing law before the break needs the law to read what has stood.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- How a formation comes to observe a stock it depends on; which schedule a law reads and where its threshold lies.
- Reading only above a threshold, or in other shapes: a raise may change the reading, not stated.
- A comparison with the rest fixed in Becoming.Runaway: there the rest is arbitrary but fixed, here it follows the law without being fixed, and neither implies the other.
- **Counterexample:** The draw witness: every strengths of the law couple the stock into itself, so a bound on strengths does not show that the loop closes only at the break; before the break the dynamics are those of the standing law, which has no such loop. ### Correspondence

This result joins them within one law. Readings (the AI's, agreed by Ren on 16 October 2026: “agree in general”): a runaway's break is where a loop forms, the distance not coupling in, in Becoming.Runaway, and the formation of Becoming.Closing being one event seen from two sides; what lets the distance couple in is a reading of the stock's level before the break, which forms the loop earlier.
